The customer pushes back three separate times with specific, credible detail about her property, and each time the rep restates the same satellite-based tree argument rather than offering any path to a physical reassessment. The DQ itself is likely substantively correct given the imagery, but the execution left the customer feeling unheard and the call ended with no resolution path or referral offered.
